name: cpig-77-offset-contours
description: 77 Field Offset Contours (R6.5 Phase E Batch 1 — Streamlines)

setup.vlmDescription: NOT YET VERIFIED — render was blank on first bring-up. When fixed: concentric or parallel light-blue contour lines on a planar region.
setup.whatItDoes: Extracts a base iso-contour and offset copies spaced in field-value space. Produces concentric or parallel contour curves.
setup.whatYouShouldSee: NOTE: first bring-up render was BLANK. The Contours output should show offset contour lines.

requires.fix: install the Slop yak package; on a dev machine a Release net48 build ships it to the Drive folder GH loads from - check `canary doctor` output for the location actually in use
install the CPig yak package, or on a dev machine build %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% CPig.Grasshopper (net48) and register its output folder in Grasshopper Developer Settings
this test loads a Slop definition from the CANARY_REPO_CPIG repo; check that repo out and point %CANARY_REPO_CPIG% at it (see workloads/tokens.json)
